repos_data.description: Voice-to-text dictation app with local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud models (BYOK). Privacy-first and available cross-platform.

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
Native macOS menu-bar AI assistant & query router. Ask instantly with a hotkey — get fast in-app BYOK answers or route to ChatGPT & CLI agents in 1 click.
The best open-source alternative to Superwhisper & Wispr Flow. Voice-to-text app for macOS with no subscription

Textream is a free macOS teleprompter app for streamers, interviewers, and presenters. It highlights your script in real-time as you speak, displayed in a beautiful Dynamic Island overlay. With extensible features.
A macOS voice, screenshot, clipboard, and coding-agent workbench.
Hold Fn key, speak, paste transcribed text. macOS menu bar app.
Transparent macOS disk cleaner — groups files by app, moves to Trash (never permanent). SwiftUI + Liquid Glass, built for macOS Tahoe.
Minimalist active window highlighting mac app
Native local-first macOS speech-to-text, live captions, subtitle editing, offline translation, and on-device Gemma 4 transcript enhancement.

MCP server + CLI for AI-powered design fidelity — compare Figma designs or screenshots against rendered UI. 90% mutation recall, zero false positives on a golden eval set. No API keys — uses your Claude Code or Codex subscription.

repo_meta_data.description: Talk to your Mac — a native macOS voice assistant that sees your screen, drives your Mac, and answers back. Powered by the OpenAI Realtime API. Open source.
